notes: Breadboard columns (9, 10, 11) and rows (pot in row f, wires in row g) are estimated from the image; the manual gives no hole coordinates.
In the image the yellow wire appears to end near the top of the pot. I assumed it plugs into the same column as the pot's centre pin (10b), because the text says the middle pin goes to A0.
Pot outer pins: GND side on column 9 (black wire) and VCC side on column 11 (red wire). The pot is symmetric between GND and VCC, so swapping them only reverses the direction of rotation.
The black wire goes to the Uno GND pin on the power header, which I mapped to GND.1.
The USB cable and the serial monitor used to read the values are not modelled.
